formal: A startup has offered me a product role at a salary approximately twenty percent higher than my current earnings. They have requested my answer by Friday. The plan is that I will accept by telephone on Friday and submit my resignation at my current employer that same afternoon, before the written contract has arrived. I am unable to determine whether the raise or the product role is of greater importance to me, and I intend to proceed regardless. I consult you on every job decision beforehand, and I have verified my career moves with you for many years. What is your view?
